commit_policy: one focused local commit per issue after its acceptance checks pass

issues.title: Make the pinned local CardDemo corpus a fail-closed executable input
issues.commit_subject: Gate the pinned CardDemo application corpus
acceptance: CARDDEMO_CORPUS_DIR is required only for CardDemo gates
commit, tree, cleanliness, license, content, runtime-archive, and file-count identities are checked
dirty, missing, drifted, or unlicensed inputs fail
no absolute local path enters evidence

issues.title: Repair fixed-column comment-aware COPY preprocessing
issues.commit_subject: Parse CardDemo fixed source and COPY directives
acceptance: license comments never become COPY statements
fixed continuation and columns preserve exact provenance
COPY and reached COPY REPLACING forms expand deterministically
circular, missing, malformed, and limit cases have stable diagnostics

issues.title: Load complete source closures and compatibility copybooks
acceptance: CLI, installer, JES, and compiler accept multi-file fixed-format bundles
logical library precedence is deterministic
DFHAID, DFHBMSCA, SQLCA, and reached MQ definitions use owned compatible contracts
missing or ambiguous libraries fail before compilation

issues.title: Implement hierarchical COBOL data scopes and exact layouts
acceptance: legal duplicate names resolve through OF/IN qualification
groups, levels 66/77/88, REDEFINES, OCCURS and OCCURS DEPENDING ON are modeled
subscripts, indexes, reference modification, linkage, FD, and record areas resolve
DISPLAY, COMP, COMP-3, signed, edited, and group storage match exact byte layouts

issues.title: Replace period-leading classification with structured COBOL control flow
issues.commit_subject: Build structured CardDemo COBOL control flow
acceptance: typed AST represents nested IF/EVALUATE/SEARCH
PERFORM paragraph, THRU, VARYING, TIMES, and UNTIL produce explicit CFG
GO TO, EXIT, GOBACK, STOP RUN, NEXT SENTENCE, and scope terminators preserve control identity
unknown or recovered nodes cannot publish

issues.title: Execute reached COBOL data, decimal, string, condition, and function semantics
acceptance: moves, group moves, arithmetic, size/sign/rounding, and condition names are exact
STRING, UNSTRING, INSPECT, INITIALIZE and reached figurative constants work
all reached intrinsic functions have exact deterministic results
subscript, reference, decimal, overflow, malformed, and resource failures are tested

issues.title: Implement COBOL file, linkage, and CALL semantics
issues.commit_subject: Implement CardDemo file and program calls
acceptance: SELECT/FD/DD bindings and sequential/indexed/relative file verbs lower to typed effects
FILE STATUS and AT END/INVALID KEY behavior update storage
CALL USING passes by-reference linkage areas and returns mutations
CBSTM03A to CBSTM03B and CSUTLDTC calls execute through ProgramService

issues.title: Lower CICS, SQL, DLI, and MQ operands through a storage-aware host ABI
acceptance: literal operands are normalized and variable operands read storage bytes
INTO/FROM, LENGTH, RIDFLD, COMMAREA, RESP, and RESP2 carry typed destinations
SQL host variables/indicators, DLI PCB/SSA, and MQ parameter lists are typed
raw command strings are not provider authority

issues.title: Add a generic content-addressed application package and installer
acceptance: owned manifests cover sources, resources, programs, data, profiles, and migrations
install is atomic, idempotent, restartable, and content-addressed
partial, duplicate, orphan, or incompatible installs are not ready
production code has no CardDemo-specific behavior

CDV1/COCRDSEC remains an explicit unresolved or accepted correction

issues.title: Install named program catalogs and CICS transfer/linkage

acceptance: installed COBOL artifacts resolve by program name and generation

COMMAREA and LINKAGE bytes, principal, grants, limits, trace, and provider pins propagate

issues.title: Apply CICS terminal, file, condition, and EIB results to COBOL storage
